status: предложено (ENV-MAPS P7 prototype + design; no UE yet)
coords: C0 px = pixel coordinates of the concept camera frame 1920x1080 (pinhole HFOV 35, pitch -55, yaw -90, distance 1.45 x fit = 2714.63 uu, looking at the map centre); the outpainted extended canvas = the same camera with a larger image plane, C0 px -383.5..2303.5 x -215.8..1295.8. World = S08 board space (X right, Y towards the K1 camera, Z up, map plane Z 0, tray top Z -3).

colour.note: the clean plate (painted lanterns / fires / cannons / banner removed) at x2 detail, pasted into the outpainted canvas; concept framing = rect [x0, y0, w, h]

seaSky.note: night sea + cloud glow without the island; only used behind the island silhouette (disocclusion) after a luma / chroma match to the extended plate's sea

bake.note: P7 track A (cp_bake.py): UE textures laid out linearly in C0 px (rectC0 = x0, y0, x1, y1), Lanczos-3 from the colour plate through the registration homography; out of git, sha256 in manifest.sarpedon.json

water.note: painted-water key (blue minus red x luma, or bright unsaturated foam) inside the waterfall / surf-bay pxRects of the overlays; B = open sea (1 - island). A helper mask for the flow animation, approximate by design

registration.model: homography C0 px -> concept px, identity within 1 px; TPS not needed

skyCylinder.note: backdrop shell for the painted sky / moon glow

islandMatte.note: island + ship = the depth sheet; the rest = sea layer (sea plane + sky cylinder). The bay water (y -40..150) stays on the sheet and ramps down to the sea level, so the matte edge across the open water at y -40 has no depth step.

cut.note: what stays real: the original map + the 3D frame-002 (4b keep). The painted surround starts 2 uu UNDER the 3D frame's outer foot, so the seam is covered by the frame; the painted frame of the concept is about 2x wider than frame-002 (outer edge ~49-50 uu from the map vs 24 uu), so the band between our frame's outer edge and the painted frame's outer edge is filled by a 1D rubber stretch of the ground just outside it (paste_proto.frame_band; the mirror fill of the first prototype made kaleidoscope patterns and was dropped, mirrorFeatherUU is unused).
cut.paintedFrameMeasured: luma profiles across the registered concept frame on the ground plane (proto measure): wood ends at ~48-50 uu (far, sand starts), ~61 (east), ~59 (west), ~85 (near: top + front face down to the rocks) from the map edge; frame-002 = 24 uu

details.note: px = top attachment; hangs down ~360 px in the concept

overlays.anim: panning foam + normal distortion of the painted water, additive / masked by the painted water luma
foam lines (panner) masked to the painted surf
UV flow distortion of the sea layer + foam panner (the sea plate already holds the painted foam)
slow UV pan of a cloud layer (optional)

layout.note: P7 track A (cp_layout.py): the env-layout overlay EnvLayouts/sarpedon.concept.layout.json (variant 'concept'): every painted prop of the base layout removed (the plate paints them), the 12 details of design.json 5_elements at their C0-ray positions (paste_proto.detail_positions, relief proxy), fires / flames as fx, fireflies over the canopy; the concept-mode lights are the profile block's (S08ArtBoardProfiles.json conceptPaste.lights, track B: true positions + flicker); the prop ids are the design ids (the block's anims / shadow blobs name them)

lantern.sizeMulNote: P7 tune (UE frames at C0): the painted lanterns read ~1.6-1.9x the 3D heads at the eye-read sizeUU; the glass centre stays on the painted glass
lantern.note: scale = painted height (sizeUU[1]) / the head's height incl. the hook; the glow centre of the head lands on the painted lantern (the detail's world point)

cannon.sizeMulNote: P7 tune (UE frames at C0): the painted barrels read ~1.35-1.4x longer / thicker than the kit cannon at the eye-read sizeUU
cannon.note: scale = painted length (sizeUU[0]) / the kit cannon's length; yaw 158 = the painted barrels (muzzle to the left and slightly to the camera, measured on the concept crop: screen (-45, +15) px -> world direction (cos 158, sin 158)); the barrel axis at the muzzle half (measured) sits on the detail's world point (ground + 22)

banner.note: scale = painted cloth width (sizeUU[0]) / the mesh cloth width; the cross-bar top on the detail's world point (top attachment); yaw: local +X = the outward normal of the ship flat towards C0, local Y along the hull line

fire.note: the clean plate keeps the painted pit / bowl: VFX only; scale from the painted fire size vs the kit campfire (40 uu x 1.2 in P5c)

fireflies.note: design.json 5_elements.reuse.fireflies; no beach light in the concept

layout.lightsNote: design.json 4_lighting_grade.pointLights: 5 points at the TRUE positions of the fires / main lanterns (+ the profile moon-pool = 6); colours / intensities of the P5c base lights they replace (campfire-nw / -w, ship lanterns); to be re-measured in UE (warm fraction >= 0.12)
